program.name: Yin Yang Yoga
program.subject: Yoga
program.blurb: A strong flow first, then long, quiet yin holds on the floor.
program.about: Two halves in every practice. The yang half is sun salutations and a standing flow that warms the body; the yin half is a few floor poses held for minutes each, hips one day and spine the next. They alternate. Both later levels hold every pose longer.
program.split: Yang flow, then yin holds, A / B
